blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas prevailed over a local Malaysian team in a tune-up game held Tuesday, three days before plunging into action in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers in Seremban. Coach Tim Cone confirmed that Gilas blew out the KL Hornbills, who are playing in Malaysia’s MBL Pro League, in the contest held at Karisma Arena in Seremban, where the Philippine team has been practicing since the weekend.
